scripts.migrate: npx ts-node --project tsconfig.json -r dotenv/config scripts/migrate.ts dotenv_config_path=.env.local
scripts.seed:categories: npx ts-node --project tsconfig.json -r dotenv/config scripts/seed-categories.ts dotenv_config_path=.env.local

scripts.seed:demo: npx ts-node --project tsconfig.json -r dotenv/config scripts/seed-demo-users.ts dotenv_config_path=.env.local
